tools.name: fitdegree_get_account
tools.description: Return the fitDEGREE account behind the API key: type (fitspot or company), identifier and label. Good first call to check the connection. API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_fitspots
tools.description: List the studio locations (fitspots) the key can see: id, name, company. Use the ids in the other list tools. API: GET /v1/fitspots.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_classes
tools.description: List the classes (the studio's class definitions, for example a yoga or spin class) with their class group. API: GET /v1/classes.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_registrables
tools.description: List the bookable sessions (registrables): one scheduled class at a studio, with start and end time, cancellation flag and class id. Use it for the schedule and for free spots. API: GET /v1/registrables.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_registrations
tools.description: List the bookings (registrations): which member is booked on which bookable session, and the status. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/registrations.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_users
tools.description: List the studio's members (users): name and contact fields as the API returns them, and their fitspot. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_sales
tools.description: List the sales (purchases of memberships, passes or other items) with the member they belong to. Cursor pagination is available: pass next_cursor back as cursor. API: GET /v1/sales.

tools.name: fitdegree_list_team_members
tools.description: List the studio's staff (team members): name, role fields and whether they are active. Use it to match instructors to sessions. API: GET /v1/team_members.
